headline: Visa Report Highlights Digital Payment Gaps for Kenyan SMEs
summary: A Visa report found that Kenyan small and medium-sized enterprises face operational and administrative hurdles due to fragmented business management systems, despite growing digital payment adoption.
why: Understanding structural adoption barriers in emerging digital economies helps investors evaluate the operational efficiency and addressable market for fintech service providers.

impacts.name: Visa Inc.
impacts.why: Adoption metrics and merchant challenges directly impact payment network volumes.
